plugins.name: colabonate
plugins.description: Use Colabonate (https://colabonate.app), a peer-to-peer marketplace and cooperation platform paid over Bitcoin Lightning and Cashu, through its MCP server. Use when the user wants to find or compare offers, buy something through a ticket, create or update an offer, browse cooperations, tenders or bounties, read DAO proposals, or check orders and notifications on Colabonate. Covers guest read-only access and token-based access with per-connection scopes. Do not use for generic Bitcoin or Lightning wallet tasks unrelated to Colabonate.
